note: Sickness from rotten food (Dave 2026-10-21): you are sick for about 1 game day (24 game hours, one real hour). Vomiting and diarrhoea: exertion cannot fall below exertion_floor (0.5) while it lasts, and every symptom_every_s real seconds one symptom costs some food and water. It fades faster asleep (sleep_mult times as fast) and by medicine (vitals.json medicines, cure_h game hours each). Shown as Sick on the inventory and Tab screens, never on the main screen. This is separate from water: clean and dirty water do not exist (Dave).

symptoms.say: Your stomach cramps and you run for the bushes

say_start: It was rotten. You feel sick.
say_too_soon: Your stomach is not ready for more yet.

infection.note: Late, uncertain sickness from raw animal food (docs/design/body_in_weather_design.md 5; Jamie #703, coordinator 8 Nov 2026, Dave may revert). Off by default: raw food in cooking.json raw_sick then sickens at once, as before. On: a food listed in odds rolls once at the bite (luck helps you escape); on a hit the sickness (its raw_sick hours) starts onset_h game hours later, with say_onset naming the food, and the food is learned as harm then. Plant toxins and rotten food are not listed and stay immediate. Raw meat has no species yet, so it takes 1 in 5. Water is not here: Dave's 21 Oct rule above stands until he says otherwise.
infection.say_onset: Your stomach turns. It was the %s %s.
